text:
```yaml
name: Label PRs

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Apply labels based on changed files
        uses: actions/labeler@v4
        with:
          configuration-path: .github/labeler.yml
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
